newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bearish mood sets in on Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bearish mood sets in on Bucharest bourse.

text.p: 1200 GMT - The bulk of Bucharest average share prices slipped at the bourse's Friday session as a bearish mood seized the market and appeared likely to keep hold of it for some time.
* Turnover fell to 6.06 billion lei from 7.9 billion on Thursday in standard end-of-the-week quieter trading.
* The first tier remained in the limelight, taking 83 percent of turnover, but volumes in this section dropped to 1.6 million shares from two million previously.
* Traders said some of the stocks had been driven to higher closing quotes by deals struck in late trading.
* Terapia pharmaceuticals company was the only first-tier stock to gain on its closing quote thanks to last- minute deals. It ended the session 50 lei stronger at 5,950.
* Policolor PLCR.BX was the star of second-tier trading, with 918 million lei in turnover and a 50-leu firmer close at 5,000.
* On the second tier, six stocks had no trade and two were suspended pending announcements.
